title: RAN ME ABRU KAMAAN KI AAMAD HAE
body:
ran me abru kamaa'n ki aamad hai
asghar-e- bezabaa'n ki aamad hai
bhuke ki natawaa'n ki aamad hai
pyaase ki neemjaa'n ki aamad hai
<<MINI>>
yahi qaime me shor hota hai
wadaa unka bhi pura hota hai
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaas ne kardiya hai ye aalam
ghash pa ghash aate hai unhe paiham
hilte hai haath paau bhi kam kam
seene me ab nahi samaata dam
<<MINI>>
gham se matam zado'n ko sakta hai
nanha syed pada sisakta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ro nahi sakte mu banaate hai
aankhe ulti huwi phiraate hai
qushk kaamoo zabaan dikhate hai
ghul se rone ke sehme jaate hai
<<MINI>>
mu khula hai dhadakti chaati hai
saans bhi ab atakti aati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
seena garmi ke maare jalta hai
nanha sa dil pada uchalta hai
dam ba dam rang ko badalta hai
bas nahi kuch kisi ka chalta hai
<<MINI>>
naam paani ka sab jo lete hai
mu ko ghabra ke khol dete hai
<<DIVIDER>>
roke kehti hai bano-e dilgeer
mai kidhar jaau kya karoo'n tadbeer
haaye bacche mere teri taqdeer
naa to paani mila tujhe naa sheer
<<MINI>>
haal jab dekhti hai bad, zainab
kehti hai ya ali madad, zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
haaye kya waqt hai pada ham par
karne paaye na maatam-e akbar
huwi darpesh rehlate asghar
ab mai nikloongi odh kar chaadar
<<MINI>>
lashkar-e- sham paas jaaungi
haal besheer ka sunaaungi
<<DIVIDER>>
kahungi jaake mai hoo'n saidaani
dekho marta hai ye mera jaani
tishnagi ki hai ispa tughyaani
waah kya qoob ki hai mehmani
<<MINI>>
karo seraab laal ko mere
paani do nounehaal ko mere
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime me aaye sarwar-e aalam
jhule se bezubaa'n ko laye haram
sheh ne dekha ke hai labo'n par dam
roke irshad ye kiya paiham
<<MINI>>
mere jaani mere jigar aao
chalo maida'n ki sair kar aao
<<DIVIDER>>
kehke ye ro-e sarwar-e- zeejaah
liya hatho'n pa apna ghirat-e- maah
kiya pinhaa'n abaa me qaatir e qaah aur kaha lallaaha– illallah
leke pyase ko ashkbaar chale
pusht qam karke be qaraar chale
<<DIVIDER>>
roke kehne lage imaam-e- ghayur
ghafilo kuch nahi hai tum ko shaoor
tum samajhna nahi quda ko door
mere bacche ka kuch nahi hai qusoor
<<MINI>>
be gunaah ki na jaan lo yaaro
mere kehne ko maan lo yaaro
<<DIVIDER>>
zalimo waasta payambar ka
dam nikalta hai mere dilbar ka
tar karo halq mere asghar ka
jaam doonga mai tum ko kausar ka
<<MINI>>
hurmala bola aab milta hai
tahro tahro jawab milta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bole karta hai kya ghazab zalim
maarta kyu'n hai besabab zalim
paani maangenge ham na ab zalim
sunta tha sheh ka kahna kab zalim
<<MINI>>
teer abroo kamaan ko maara
che mahine ki jaan ko maara
